parsed.answer: For Larch’s next outage, Mara should use REPLAY-0-632: the August 22 review instructs use of the recovery procedure validated on August 8, and the August 8 record shows REPLAY-0-632 was tested and restored the missing updates. The delivery-mode change was caused by the GATE-0-519 outages; on August 15 Mara approved switching Larch from BATCH-0-741 to STREAM-0-286, and the August 22 review kept that delivery choice. The August 8 meeting itself did not approve a delivery-mode change.

citations.quote: For the next outage, use the recovery procedure validated on August 8.
The team tested REPLAY-0-632, which restored the missing updates.
No change of delivery mode was approved at this meeting.
Mara approved switching Larch from BATCH-0-741 to STREAM-0-286.
The cause was the GATE-0-519 outages recorded on August 8
